parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: UPI ID jaise saurav@ybl, rahul@paytm, 9876543210@okaxis. Paise: 50000 rupaye. Phone number: 9876543210. Police, kidnap, accident. Phone call in Hinglish. May contain UPI IDs like name@ybl or name@okaxis, rupee amounts and phone numbers. Write threats in English exactly as the caller meant them. "Police ko mat batana" means the caller forbids contacting the police; it is not a threat to call the police. Never invent details.

additionalFields.caption: Valid8 evidence report. Please verify the details against the recording before filing on 1930 or Chakshu.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "openai/gpt-oss-120b", "temperature": 0, "reasoning_effort": "low", "include_reasoning": false, "response_format": { "type": "json_object" }, "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "You extract evidence from a transcript of a suspected Indian scam call. The transcript may be Hindi in Devanagari or Hinglish, and speech-to-text may garble words: rebuild UPI IDs (for example saurav help at ybl means saurav.help@ybl), numbers spoken in Hindi, and amounts. Never invent anything not supported by the transcript. Reply ONLY with JSON: {\"scam_type\": \"kidnap|arrest|accident|hospital|other\", \"victim_named\": string or null, \"amount_inr\": number or null, \"payment_method\": string or null, \"upi_ids\": [strings], \"phone_numbers\": [strings], \"deadline\": string or null, \"threats\": [short English strings], \"summary\": \"two short lines in English\", \"uncertain\": [fields that may be garbled]}" }, { "role": "user", "content": {{ JSON.stringify($json.text) }} } ] }
